title: Holomorphic isomonodromic deformations of Higgs bundles: absolute lifting, spectral flatness, and nilpotent rigidity
summary: Let $f:X\to S$ be a smooth projective family, and fix a semisimple flat bundle on a fiber $X_0$. Its isomonodromic deformation determines a holomorphic section $σ_{\mathrm{dR}}:S\to M_{\mathrm{dR}}(X/S)$ of the relative de Rham moduli space. Applying the relative non-abelian Hodge correspondence fiberwise gives a section $σ_{\mathrm{Dol}}:S\to M_{\mathrm{Dol}}(X/S)$, whose value at each $s\in S$ is the Higgs bundle corresponding to the flat bundle $σ_{\mathrm{dR}}(s)$.
